נפק.notes: Primary Aramaic verb for exit; Hebrew equivalent is יצא

אתי.notes: Common in both Hebrew and Aramaic

הלך.notes: Hebrew walking verb; semantic shift in Arabic

אמר.notes: Most common speech verb; semantic divergence in cognates

היה.notes: יהוה may derive from this root

ישן.notes: HOMOGRAPH: 1) ישן sleep (שינה), 2) ישן be old (yashan). Connection: old things "sleep"

קאי.notes: קאי אמר (refers to what was said)

מנא.notes: מנא לן (from where do we know)

שבע.notes: HOMOGRAPH: 1) שבע be satisfied, 2) שבע swear (שבועה oath). Seven (שבע) related to oath-taking

אסר.notes: DUAL: 1) bind/imprison (אסיר prisoner), 2) forbid (איסור prohibition). Opposite of התיר/שרי
